# Australian Reserve Props

> Studio-Grade Prop Money for Film, Theatre & Performance

Australian Reserve Props is an Australia-based novelty currency brand established in 2024, offering compliance-first prop money for film, theatre, content creation, education, and gifting. Australian Reserve Props ships Australia-wide and specialises in Australian-note-styled prop currency across our $20, $50, and $100 denominations. Every note is reproduced under RBA reproduction guidance, clearly marked NOT LEGAL TENDER, and sold for novelty and production use only.

## Contact
- Email: info@australianreserveprops.com
- WhatsApp: +61 480 804 189
- Business: Money 365 Pty Ltd · ABN 84 676 764 971 · The Ponds, NSW 2769
- Ships: Australia only

## Categories
- [$20 Prop Notes](https://australianreserveprops.com/shop/twenty-dollar-notes/): $17.95-$51.95 AUD, Australian $20-style prop notes, sized for magic tricks, photo props, and mid-range prop budgets.
- [$50 Prop Notes](https://australianreserveprops.com/shop/fifty-dollar-notes/): $19.95-$57.95 AUD, Australian $50-style prop notes, the most requested denomination for film and theatre productions.
- [$100 Prop Notes](https://australianreserveprops.com/shop/hundred-dollar-notes/): $20.95-$62.95 AUD, Australian $100-style prop notes for briefcase scenes, high-stakes narratives, and premium-looking stacks.
- [Vintage & Legacy Series](https://australianreserveprops.com/shop/vintage-series-notes/): $28.95-$36.95 AUD, Older-style Australian note designs for period productions — the look of a different decade without the compliance shortcuts, still reduced-scale and marked NOT LEGAL TENDER.
- [Packs & Bundles](https://australianreserveprops.com/shop/packs-bundles/): $36.95-$93.95 AUD, Mixed-denomination and bulk packs for productions and events needing more than a single note type.
- [Briefcases & Bags](https://australianreserveprops.com/shop/briefcases-bags/): $135.00-$240.00 AUD, Note stacks pre-packed into a briefcase or duffel bag for reveal scenes — open the lid and the shot is dressed.
- [Confetti & Party Favors](https://australianreserveprops.com/shop/confetti-party-favors/): $10.95-$30.95 AUD, Money-print confetti, shredded cash, and money leis for parties, celebrations, and events.
- [Display & Collectibles](https://australianreserveprops.com/shop/display-collectibles/): $72.95-$156.00 AUD, Framed and cased display pieces for collectors, offices, and set dressing.
- [Personalised & Novelty](https://australianreserveprops.com/shop/personalised-novelty/): $34.95-$41.95 AUD, Personalised photo notes and novelty big cheques for gag gifts and presentations — never a real financial instrument.
- [Kids Play Money](https://australianreserveprops.com/shop/kids-play-money/): $20.95-$62.95 AUD, Educational Australian-style play money for classrooms, pretend play, and teaching kids to count currency.
- [Gift Sets](https://australianreserveprops.com/shop/gift-sets/): $30.95-$41.95 AUD, Novelty money gift boxes for birthdays, graduations, and gag gifts.
- [Accessories](https://australianreserveprops.com/shop/accessories/): $7.95-$28.95 AUD, Money guns, refill packs, and display cases to go with your prop notes.

## Compliance
All products are reproduced to differ from genuine Australian currency by at least 25% in size, per RBA
reproduction guidance, are clearly marked NOT LEGAL TENDER, and carry no replicated banknote security features.
No custom or buyer-specified serial numbers are offered under any circumstances.
